entry.title: crashing a lightning node with a flood of pings
entry.summary: Core Lightning answered every ping and gossip query even when the peer refused to read the replies. One connection could grow the outgoing queue until the node ran out of memory. Here's the OOM, and the backpressure fix that closed it.

entry.title: onion message jamming in the lightning network
entry.summary: BOLT 12 is rolling out everywhere, and the onion message rate limits we ship today protect the node but not the network. Here's the attack, and four ways out.
